narr: Showers and storms developed along a frontal boundary as it moved south across the region. Locally heavy rainfall produced flash flooding in several locations.
ev: Up to four inches of rain fell in a short amount of time causing flash flooding. Several roads were flooded including several locations on Illinois Route 13 between Lenzburg and New Athens.
lsr: FAST FLOWING WATER OVER ROUTE 13 NEAR LENZBURG.
